thread:
mia: Hey team — new customer story incoming from Sarelia Health. They signed the case study LOI yesterday. Quick intake: wants a short writeup + 30-min customer webinar tied to launch week. Can we sync on next steps?

olivia: awesome — congrats! do we have the final approved logo/legal asset list from them?

mia: yes, marketing ops has a zip from their comms lead (dropbox link in DM). embargo requested until 2026-05-12.

kevin: heads-up: CS can provide performance numbers (latency, cost savings) and a short customer quote. need to confirm anonymization level.

sara-legal: I'll review the LOI and the quote language. flagging one clause: they want to include a specific throughput metric tied to their internal SLA — we'll need written permission to publish the exact number.

mia: noted. can we get a permissive quote with optional redaction like: “We saw ~X% cost reduction and stable P95” and then fill once legal confirms?

jacob-cs: happy to draft a tight quote. quick draft: "Redwood’s dedicated routing cut our inference unit cost by 41% and reduced 95th pct latency by 28% during peak traffic." happy to change numbers to ranges if legal prefers.

sara-legal: prefer ranges or "~" prefix for public copy. also: include a short approval workflow — customer must sign off on final numbers. I can send edits in-line.

mia: timeline ask — I want the case story copy + assets by 2026-04-25 for a 2026-05-12 embargo. webinar target week is 2026-05-19 (post-embargo). Is that doable?

olivia: marketing can support. need TOFU/lead routing: should webinar registrations go straight to sales AE queue or to nurture?

kevin: route to AE queue but tag by campaign source + a pre-qualification field (self-serve vs enterprise). we'll set up an auto-segmentation rule: if company_size > 500 or monthly_usage_est > threshold -> enterprise AE.

mia: perfect. can we capture a short form field: "interested in dedicated/private" yes/no so ops can route accordingly?

jacob-cs: will add a 2-question pre-survey at registration: 1) primary use-case, 2) deployment interest (hosted/dedicated/private).

mia: below is the suggested interview script — please comment.

```
Interview guide (15-20 min)
1) Quick intro: team + role
2) What problem were you trying to solve? (prior infra, pain)
3) Why Redwood? what was the deciding factor?
4) Metrics and outcomes (cost, latency, reliability) — ask for numbers and whether shareable
5) Anecdote: a concrete customer story of a live incident or cutover
6) One-sentence advice for teams evaluating inference platforms
```

kevin: looks good. we'll try to capture a short video clip and a 1-paragraph spotlight + quote.

sara-legal: I uploaded redlines to the LOI and a suggested public quote template. key public language: avoid naming internal job titles and avoid unredacted SLA numbers.

mia: thanks — can you ping the customer for numeric approval once legal signs off?

sara-legal: on it. I'll also ask them to approve the webinar slide deck excerpt with the metric callouts.

deploy-bot: Recording slot scheduled: 2026-04-22 14:00 PT — "Sarelia - Customer Spotlight Interview". Calendar invites sent.

mia: awesome. action items summary: 1) jacob — finalize draft quote and share by 2026-04-18; 2) sara — finish LOI redlines + request numeric signoff by 2026-04-20; 3) kevin — prepare metrics + 2-3 backup datapoints; 4) olivia — set up webinar registration with pre-survey and AE routing tags; 5) marketing ops — confirm asset zip and embargo controls.

olivia: will build the registration flow and report back with a test link by EOD Monday.

jacob-cs: working on quote now, will drop first pass later today.

sara-legal: started redlines, ETA tomorrow noon.

mia: thanks all — keeping this thread for status updates. :rocket:

kevin: one more note — suggest we A/B test two webinar CTAs: "See our benchmark" vs "Talk to an expert" to optimize lead quality.

mia: good call. add as an experiment to the registration build.

olivia: noted. adding CTA variant and UTMs.

mia: great. I'll update the customer-facing timeline once legal confirms numbers.

jacob-cs: quote dropped in thread DM to @mia (short).

sara-legal: sent signed approval request to customer contact. awaiting reply.

mia: closing loop — thanks team. will move to promo plan once we have final quote + asset pack. :sparkles:
